headline: Saudi Arabian Economy Shrinks 3.8% as War Impairs Oil Production
summary: Saudi Arabia's economy contracted by 3.8% as active conflict disrupted crude oil production.
why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest exporter of crude oil and the dominant economy in the Gulf Cooperation Council.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: War-related crude oil output cuts reduced total economic output by 3.8%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Saudi gross domestic product contracted 3.8% due to military conflict disrupting national oil production.
